english_draft:
Meta 2026 Q3 Preview (historical reconstruction). This is a retrospective preview. It was not written before the actual Q3 earnings release. It uses only information public before 2026-07-29.

Bottom line: Q2 2026 revenue was USD 60.801 billion, up 28% year over year. Operating income was USD 18.775 billion, down 8% year over year. Operating margin was 31%, versus 43% a year earlier. GAAP diluted EPS was USD 6.18.

Costs and expenses were USD 42.026 billion. This amount includes USD 2.40 billion of legal charges and USD 1.18 billion of severance related to the May 2026 headcount reduction.

Company Q3 2026 revenue outlook: USD 61-64 billion. This is a forecast, not an actual result. The source does not provide Q3 2025 revenue, so this preview does not calculate implied year-over-year growth.

Baseline: Family daily active people averaged 3.60 billion in June 2026. Ad impressions grew 14% year over year. Average ad price grew 12% year over year. Capital expenditure including finance leases was USD 31.08 billion as disclosed; the source gives no quarterly split.

Core questions: 1) Will Q3 revenue land within the USD 61-64 billion range? 2) Will operating margin recover after the legal and severance charges? 3) Will capital expenditure continue to accelerate?

Positive surprise: revenue above USD 64 billion; operating margin recovers; ad impressions and ad price both keep growing. Negative surprise: revenue below USD 61 billion; operating margin remains weak; capital expenditure accelerates without faster revenue growth.

Verification points: Q3 revenue, GAAP operating income/margin, GAAP diluted EPS, ad impressions, average ad price, Family DAP, capital expenditure including finance leases, and any updated full-year capex guidance.

来源没有2025Q3收入基数，公司给的610亿—640亿美元指引到底对应怎样的同比增速？在没有共识数据时，如何判断指引是偏强还是偏弱？

Operating income USD 18.775 billion, down 8% year over year; operating margin 31% versus 43%; diluted EPS USD 6.18.
Costs and expenses USD 42.026 billion include USD 2.40 billion of legal charges and USD 1.18 billion of severance from the May 2026 headcount reduction.
Family daily active people averaged 3.60 billion in June 2026; ad impressions grew 14% and average ad price grew 12% year over year.
Capital expenditure including finance leases USD 31.08 billion; company Q3 revenue outlook USD 61-64 billion is a forecast.
